source: scripts/smoke/move-envelope-matrix.sh PROOF_NAMES including generic resource graph proof rows
goal: Map existing proven move proof rows to normalized resource classes so generic resource graph support is grounded in graduated envelope behavior.

resourceClasses.processIdentity: Executable path/package/content identity and target-native executable policy.
resourceClasses.targetPackageIdentity: Target-native package or executable identity required before service reexec.
resourceClasses.targetPackageMissing: Missing target-native package or executable is refused before service target launch.
resourceClasses.argvEnvCwd: Argument vector, environment policy, current working directory, and safe path shape.
resourceClasses.regularFileIdentity: Regular non-symlink file identity such as size and sha256.
resourceClasses.directoryIdentity: Directory or tree identity with symlink policy, ordering policy, and digest evidence.
resourceClasses.filesystemMutation: Target filesystem precondition plus deterministic mutation and postcondition.
resourceClasses.atomicOutput: Output can be recreated atomically by target-native execution rather than continuing a partial write.
resourceClasses.archiveMemberPolicy: Archive member names, metadata, overwrite, symlink, hardlink, and traversal policy.
resourceClasses.loopbackTcpListener: Loopback listener identity and target port availability.
resourceClasses.noActiveClients: Evidence that a listener has no active client/request/session that must be preserved.
resourceClasses.serviceConfigIdentity: Daemon config or module identity for target-native restart.
resourceClasses.serviceConfigDrift: Daemon config, argv contract, module config sha, or equivalent service config identity changed and is refused before target continuation.
resourceClasses.dataDirIdentity: Mutable directory tree identity, ownership/mode, and symlink policy.
resourceClasses.databaseSafety: Database-specific WAL/checkpoint/feature gates required before target-native data-dir safety support or fail-closed refusal.
resourceClasses.databaseWalAmbiguity: Database WAL or checkpoint history ambiguity is refused until log ordering, replay, and checkpoint reconciliation semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.databaseActiveWriter: Active database writers or dirty mutable data-dir state are refused until quiescence and write ordering are modeled.
resourceClasses.databaseFileLock: Database data-dir locks, leases, or lock-owner state are refused outside exact modeled lock/database ownership semantics.
resourceClasses.databaseNonEmptyPersistence: Non-empty persistent database datasets without database-specific semantics are refused; empty/no-persistence proof rows do not migrate data.
resourceClasses.databaseDirtyCheckpoint: Dirty checkpoints or unclean shutdown evidence are refused until checkpoint recovery/replay policy is modeled.
resourceClasses.dataDirOwnershipModeChanged: Changed target data-dir ownership or mode policy refuses before target continuation.
resourceClasses.dataDirSymlinkHazard: Data-dir symlinks or path escapes are refused until safe traversal and identity semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.databaseServiceSpecificUnsafe: Service-specific database features such as auth, modules, replication, or config side effects remain refused outside exact rows.
resourceClasses.sameArchNativeResume: Proof-only same-architecture target-native execution/resume evidence for one single-thread modeled code shape with no source-ISA emulation.
resourceClasses.frozenThreadState: Frozen single-thread state evidence including stop policy and modeled register bank before same-arch continuation.
resourceClasses.registerStackMemoryEvidence: Register bank, stack window, executable memory mapping, and target entry evidence required before same-arch continuation can be claimed.
resourceClasses.fdResourceGraphCompatibility: All observed fd/resource classes are modeled or refused before same-arch continuation; no source fd teleportation is implied.
resourceClasses.sameArchActiveSyscallRefusal: Same-architecture continuation refuses active in-kernel syscall state until synthetic return/resource readiness semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.sameArchMultiThreadRefusal: Same-architecture continuation refuses multiple threads until scheduler, TLS, futex, signal, and target thread-start semantics are proven.
resourceClasses.sameArchUnsupportedMapping: Same-architecture continuation refuses unsupported memory mappings such as dirty anonymous, writable executable, unbounded, or identity-unknown mappings.
resourceClasses.sameArchRuntimeHeapRefusal: Runtime heap assumptions and runtime-profile shortcuts are refused for same-arch continuation; modeled native resources are required instead.
resourceClasses.sameArchSignalStateRefusal: Same-architecture continuation refuses pending signals, caught handlers, and process-group/session ambiguity until exact signal semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.sameArchFdRefusal: Same-architecture continuation refuses unsupported file descriptors and runtime-owned fds rather than teleporting source fd state.
resourceClasses.sameArchResourceGraphGap: Same-architecture continuation refuses when any observed resource class is missing from the descriptor/resource graph.
resourceClasses.crossArchSemanticDescriptor: Cross-architecture support uses semantic descriptors, not source registers, source stacks, or source-ISA process state.
resourceClasses.crossArchTargetNativeTool: Target continuation evidence must come from a target-native binary or proof-provisioned target-native tool on the target architecture.
resourceClasses.crossArchSemanticReconstruction: Proof-only cross-architecture semantic reconstruction for one exact finite byte-stream transform with target-visible output and no source-ISA execution.
resourceClasses.crossArchMetadataOnlyRefusal: Cross-architecture metadata-only success is refused unless target-native execution produces visible continuation evidence.
resourceClasses.crossArchSourceIsaEmulationRefusal: Cross-architecture source-ISA emulation or source ISA execution requests are refused before target launch.
resourceClasses.crossArchRuntimeProfileShortcutRefusal: Cross-architecture runtime-profile shortcuts are refused; support must come from exact semantic/resource descriptors and target-native tools.
resourceClasses.crossArchArbitraryElfProcessRefusal: Arbitrary ELF/process movement claims are refused without exact semantic descriptors and modeled dependencies.
resourceClasses.crossArchUnsupportedResourceDescriptor: Unsupported cross-architecture resource descriptors are refused until target-native semantic reconstruction exists for that resource class.
resourceClasses.crossArchMissingTargetNativeBinary: Missing target-native binaries or tools refuse instead of falling back to sidecars, source ISA execution, or metadata-only success.
resourceClasses.crossArchIncompleteDependencyGraph: Incomplete cross-architecture dependency/resource graphs are refused before target launch.
resourceClasses.healthProbe: Target-side command, process, TCP, HTTP, or protocol evidence after launch.
resourceClasses.unsupportedResourceRefusal: Known unsupported resource class produces fail-closed evidence before target launch or with targetPid=null.
resourceClasses.runtimeSpecificRefusal: Runtime or framework-specific state is explicitly refused until a generic resource model exists.
resourceClasses.terminalOrPtyRefusal: Interactive terminal/PTY/editor state is refused until the PTY resource class graduates.
resourceClasses.terminalOrPtyEvidence: PTY descriptor evidence records fd/path and, where preflight can read it, termios, winsize, session, process-group, foreground process-group, tty, and fd flags while staying fail-closed.
resourceClasses.terminalPtyTranscriptProbe: Proof-only noninteractive PTY transcript/probe support reexecs a marked target-native command under a PTY with captured termios/winsize/session evidence and captures output transcript; it is not interactive terminal migration.
resourceClasses.terminalEditorDirtyState: Dirty editor buffer state on a PTY is refused until editor/session contents and terminal mode are explicitly modeled.
resourceClasses.terminalAlternateScreenState: Alternate-screen terminal applications are refused until screen buffer and terminal mode policy are explicitly modeled.
resourceClasses.terminalJobControlState: Shell job-control state on a PTY is refused until session, process group, foreground group, and jobs are explicitly modeled.
resourceClasses.terminalForegroundProcessGroup: Foreground process-group ambiguity on a PTY is refused until target-native session reconstruction has exact evidence.
resourceClasses.terminalUnknownTermios: Unknown or unavailable termios state is refused until terminal mode capture and replay are explicit.
resourceClasses.terminalWindowSize: Unknown or unsupported terminal window-size transitions are refused until winsize capture/replay policy is explicit.
resourceClasses.regularFileCursor: Read-only regular-file descriptor cursor identity with dev/inode/mtime/hash and target-side offset reconstruction.
resourceClasses.appendFileCursorRefusal: Unsafe append-only regular-file fd candidates are identified and refused when the fd is not at EOF, target identity changed, flags are unsupported, or lock/mmap/inotify/fanotify/concurrent-writer interactions are present.
resourceClasses.fileLockAdvisory: Proof-only target-native reacquisition of one exact flock whole-file advisory lock with path/file identity, owner policy, and nonblocking conflict probe evidence before launch; not broad lock migration.
resourceClasses.fileLockConflict: Target lock conflict refuses with targetPid=null before continuation is accepted.
resourceClasses.fileLockBackingChanged: Changed target lock backing file identity refuses before target pid.
resourceClasses.fileLockUnknownOwner: File locks with unknown owners are refused until owner identity can be reconstructed exactly.
resourceClasses.fileLockMandatory: Mandatory locks are refused until mandatory-lock semantics and enforcement policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.fileLockLease: File leases are refused until lease break, signal, and owner semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.fileLockNonseekable: Nonseekable or invalid lock offsets/ranges are refused until range semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.fileLockUnsupportedType: Unsupported lock types such as POSIX/OFD variants remain refused outside the exact flock proof row.
resourceClasses.fileLockCrossProcessOwner: Cross-process lock ownership is refused until the owning process graph and lock ownership transfer are modeled.
resourceClasses.unixSocketRefusal: Unix domain socket shapes are classified and refused until pathname listener and related socket contracts graduate.
resourceClasses.anonInodeRefusal: Anon-inode resources such as eventfd, epoll, timerfd, signalfd, inotify, fanotify, and io_uring are classified and refused until explicit contracts graduate.
resourceClasses.inotifyFileFollow: Proof-only target-native reconstruction of one inotify IN_MODIFY watch on a stable regular file with file identity preflight and future-event-only target-visible follow evidence; queued events and broad watcher migration remain refused.
resourceClasses.inotifyBaseline: Inotify states outside the one-file future-event follow contract remain refused, including queued event replay and unsupported masks.
resourceClasses.inotifyQueuedEvents: Captured or unknown queued inotify events are refused until event ordering and replay semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.inotifyDroppedEvents: Dropped or overflowed inotify event state is refused until loss accounting and recovery semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.inotifyDirectoryMutationRace: Directory-tree mutation races under inotify watches are refused until directory event ordering and tree consistency are modeled.
resourceClasses.inotifyRecursiveWatch: Recursive or multi-watch inotify trees are refused until complete watch graph reconstruction is modeled.
resourceClasses.inotifyWatchIdentityChanged: Changed target watched-file identity refuses before target pid.
resourceClasses.fanotifyPermissionEvent: fanotify permission events and decision state are refused until permission-event replay/decision semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.inotifyUnsupportedMask: Inotify masks outside the exact IN_MODIFY file-follow proof shape are refused until mask-specific semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.mmapFileBackedClean: Proof-only target-native reconstruction of one clean file-backed read-only or clean MAP_SHARED mapping using path, offset, length, permissions, sharing, and file identity preflight with target-visible mapped bytes.
resourceClasses.mmapFileBaseline: mmap states outside the clean file-backed proof shape remain refused, including dirty pages, anonymous mappings, writable/executable mappings, truncation races, and changed backing files.
resourceClasses.mmapDirtyShared: Dirty MAP_SHARED file-backed mappings are refused until dirty range capture and backing file reconciliation are modeled.
resourceClasses.mmapDirtyPrivate: Dirty MAP_PRIVATE copy-on-write mappings are refused until private dirty page materialization is modeled.
resourceClasses.mmapAnonymousDirty: Anonymous dirty mappings are refused until memory capture and target materialization are modeled.
resourceClasses.mmapWritableExecutable: Writable/executable mapping hazards are refused until permissions, code identity, and W^X policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.mmapTruncationRace: Mappings with backing-file truncation or size races are refused until race-free identity and bounds policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.mmapBackingChanged: Changed target mmap backing file identity refuses before target pid.
resourceClasses.appendFileCursor: Append-only regular-file descriptor continuation for exact O_APPEND log fds captured at EOF with portable size+sha256 identity preflight and target-visible append progress.
resourceClasses.unixSocketPathnameListener: Narrow idle pathname Unix listener with stable filesystem socket path, no active clients, target path preflight, and Unix-connect health probe.
resourceClasses.eventfdEpollBaseline: Refusal-preserving eventfd/epoll descriptor evidence records eventfd counters and epoll watched fd metadata, trigger modes, one-shot state, watched resource classes, unsupported flags, incompatible counters, and active-wait/runtime-loop ambiguity without accepting reconstruction.
resourceClasses.eventfdCounter: Tiny target-native eventfd reconstruction for one normal-flag eventfd with a modeled counter and no active waiter or epoll/runtime-loop ambiguity.
resourceClasses.epollEventfdWatch: Tiny target-native epoll reconstruction for one epoll set watching the supported eventfd with modeled level-trigger/no-one-shot semantics and no active loop ambiguity.
resourceClasses.epollTimerfdWatch: Tiny target-native epoll reconstruction for one epoll set watching the supported relative one-shot timerfd with modeled level-trigger/no-one-shot readiness and target-visible timer readiness evidence.
resourceClasses.timerfdRelativeOneShot: Tiny target-native timerfd reconstruction for one normal-flag CLOCK_MONOTONIC relative one-shot timer with captured remaining expiry, zero interval, no unread expirations, and bounded target firing skew evidence.
resourceClasses.timerfdBaseline: Timerfd variants outside the relative one-shot contract, including realtime, absolute, periodic, nonblocking, unread expiration, and active-wait ambiguity, remain refused.
resourceClasses.signalMaskDispositionEvidence: Signal masks, ignored/caught disposition bitmaps, pending masks, session, and process group evidence are recorded separately from fd resources for fail-closed signal-state decisions.
resourceClasses.signalfdBaseline: signalfd descriptors remain refused until signal mask, pending queue, delivery ordering, and target-side signalfd reconstruction semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.pendingSignalState: Pending process/thread signal delivery is refused until queued delivery, ordering, and handler interaction semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.processGroupSignalAmbiguity: Signal state depending on ambiguous process group/session membership is refused until exact group reconstruction is modeled.
resourceClasses.runtimeManagedSignalTimer: Runtime-managed signal timers such as setitimer/SIGALRM are refused until timer and signal delivery state are modeled together.
resourceClasses.unknownSignalHandler: Caught or application-installed signal handlers are refused until handler identity and target delivery policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.serviceStaticRoot: Static service root identity for target-native static/read-only service restart.
resourceClasses.serviceReadOnlyData: Read-only service data contract with no writable persistence or mutation replay claim.
resourceClasses.serviceWritablePersistence: Writable service data roots are explicitly refused until mutation replay, ownership, locking, and consistency policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.authHooksOrSecrets: Authentication users, secrets files, hooks, or access-control side effects are explicitly refused until secret material and hook execution policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.reverseProxyOrUpstreamSocket: Reverse proxy or upstream socket configuration is explicitly refused until upstream endpoint/session policy is modeled.
resourceClasses.dynamicRuntimeOrAppCode: Dynamic runtime/app-code service behavior is explicitly refused until app/runtime state is modeled.
resourceClasses.serviceManagedChildWorkers: Service-managed worker pools or child processes are explicitly refused or left blocked until safe process-tree reconstruction is modeled.
resourceClasses.serviceEmptyDataset: Empty service dataset contract for stateful services whose supported shape requires no keys/data and no persistence.
resourceClasses.nodeLibuvRuntimeFds: Node/libuv runtime-owned event-loop fds (epoll, eventfd, internal pipes, listener socket, and log stdio) recreated by target-native Node reexec only for exact marker-proven static HTTP shapes; not source-fd continuation.
resourceClasses.nativeStaticHttpRuntimeFds: Runtime-owned listener/socket/log stdio and language runtime fds recreated by target-native reexec only for exact marker-proven native static HTTP binaries; not source-fd continuation.
resourceClasses.nativeListenerRuntimeFds: Runtime-owned listener sockets, auxiliary socket noise, and log stdio recreated by target-native reexec only for exact marker-proven listener/responder shapes; not source-fd continuation.
resourceClasses.stdioLogOutput: Deterministic stdout/stderr output modeled as target-created generic loader log output for exact product rows; not source FIFO/log fd continuation.
resourceClasses.processGraph: Exact moved process graph with modeled nodes, parent/pipe edges, argv/env/cwd/executable identity per node, and target-native reexec policy; not arbitrary process-tree checkpointing.
resourceClasses.pipeGraph: Anonymous pipe graph descriptor evidence including pipe topology, producer/consumer fd roles, flags, close-on-exec/nonblocking policy, buffered-data policy, and lifecycle support/refusal boundaries.
resourceClasses.stdio: Standard input/output/error policy for target-native generic loaders, including dev-null, modeled pipe, modeled PTY transcript, inherited noninteractive, or refused nontrivial stdio.
resourceClasses.dynamicWorkerPool: Dynamic worker pools with changing child membership are refused until exact process-tree lifecycle and worker membership reconstruction are modeled.
resourceClasses.activeRequestSession: Active in-flight requests or sessions are refused until protocol quiescence and session state reconstruction are explicitly modeled.
resourceClasses.serviceReloadRace: Overlapping daemon generations or reload races are refused until generation handoff and config/process identity are explicitly modeled.
resourceClasses.nonExactProcessTree: Incomplete, ambiguous, or non-exact process-tree descriptors are refused; exact node and edge identity is required before target-native process-tree reconstruction.
resourceClasses.unixSocketPathnameClientPair: Exact pathname Unix listener plus target-created protocol client probe with stable filesystem path, target path preflight, and no connected session, abstract namespace, datagram, fd-passing, or credential-sensitive socket claim.
resourceClasses.unixSocketConnected: Connected Unix socket sessions are refused until peer/session queues and stream state can be modeled exactly.
resourceClasses.unixSocketAbstract: Abstract namespace Unix sockets are refused until abstract path identity and target namespace reconstruction are modeled.
resourceClasses.unixSocketDatagram: Unix datagram sockets are refused until message queue ordering and peer semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.unixSocketPair: Unix socketpairs are refused until ambiguous peer state and bidirectional queue semantics are modeled.
resourceClasses.unixSocketFdPassing: Unix sockets carrying SCM_RIGHTS/fd-passing semantics are refused until passed-fd graph capture and target reconstruction are modeled.
resourceClasses.unixSocketCredentialSensitive: Credential-sensitive Unix sockets are refused until peer credentials and authorization policy are modeled.
resourceClasses.unixSocketPathOccupied: Occupied target Unix socket pathname refuses before target pid.
resourceClasses.unixSocketPathMissingParent: Missing target Unix socket parent directory refuses before target pid.
resourceClasses.unixSocketPathIdentityChanged: Changed target Unix socket pathname identity refuses before target pid.
